correctness.summary: The mirror total variation is exactly the L1 norm of the odd Walsh part of the product density. Walsh orthogonality bounds all degree-at-least-three terms by a q^(3/2) remainder, while Delta^2 lies between q(1-q/2) and q, giving the uniform O(q) profile formula. Standard triangular-array convergence then gives the Rademacher-Gaussian profile law. The Bernoulli-product corollary follows from an exact midpoint-contrast variance v/(2-v), the same odd-product expansion, and a Lindeberg CLT. Standalone enumeration and binomial checks reproduce the quantitative and asymptotic formulas.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Smirnov 2026 introduces the same mirror products and proves only an unspecified constant-factor comparison, already using Khintchine in the lower-bound proof. Searches did not locate the displayed weak-signal Rademacher profile approximation, its complete Rademacher-Gaussian subsequential classification, the exact [1/sqrt(2),1] local limit range, or the diffuse constants in Smirnov's coordinates. Sharp Khintchine constants, triangular-array CLT/LAN, and generic distinguishability inequalities are prior art. The main residual risk is the source paper's announced but not separately identified future quantum treatment.

value.summary: The result sharpens a new constant-factor theorem by resolving the complete weak-signal efficiency geometry: sparse, balanced, and diffuse signals have distinct exact limits, every value from 1/sqrt(2) to 1 occurs, and a natural diffuse Bernoulli-product regime has an explicit first-order total-variation constant.

limitations: The 2q estimate is local in q and no global optimal constant for the source theorem is claimed.
The complete profile theorem concerns the mirror-product conditional problem rather than arbitrary non-diffuse Bernoulli products.
The direct product asymptotic assumes V tends to zero and max_i a_i^2/V tends to zero.
The source announces a future quantum treatment that was not available as a separately identifiable public paper.
Independent audit has not been performed.
